  • Avoid sky-high roaming charges with a Global eSIM plan. Whether you’re exploring as a tourist or closing business deals, stay connected in 121 destinations with prepaid Global data.

  • Sightseeing in Italy? Surfing in Australia? Or sunbathing in Brazil? Find the best mobile data plan for your trip, with options ranging from 1 GB to 20 GB. If you’re hitting multiple destinations in a continent, browse regional data options like an eSIM for Africa or Latin America. Just pick your data plan, download the Saily app, and enjoy easy internet access while you travel.

  • Sometimes, your only internet option while abroad is an unsecured public Wi-Fi network. Keep hackers at bay — use the Saily eSIM app with built-in security features.

  • Removing and inserting a tiny SIM card leaves opportunities for you to lose or damage it. With an eSIM app, instantly get mobile data plans from the comfort of your phone — no card required!

  • Device compatibility: Works with all eSIM-compatible devices.

  • Plan activation: Automatic, when you arrive at your first destination (as long as you’ve turned on your eSIM in the device’s settings and enabled roaming).

  • Delivery time: Instant. If you’ve purchased your Saily data plan through the website, you will instantly get a QR code via email for easy setup. If you’ve purchased an eSIM through the app, you’ll instantly see it on your profile.

  • Plan duration: Either 7, 15, 60, 180, or 365 days.

  • Data plans: From 1 GB to 50 GB.

  • SMS: Yes, SMS are available with a Saily phone number and text message plan for Global.

  • Calls: Yes, Saily offers an eSIM with a phone number, so calls are available with a minutes plan for Global. Keep in mind that call minutes cover both incoming and outgoing calls. If you only need a data plan, you can call through apps (VoIP), such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, and Facebook Messenger.

  • Speed: 3G/4G/LTE/5G, depending on local network providers.

  • Hotspot: Enjoy limitless hotspot sharing with friends and family.

  • Coverage: Stay connected in 121 destinations around the globe, including the US, Canada, Spain, Italy, Japan, Indonesia, Brazil, South Africa, Australia, and many more! Please note that coverage quality will depend on local network providers.

  • Network: Stable and reliable connection from local network providers in your destination country.

  • Top-ups: Easily top up with more GBs in the app when you’re running low — your new data plan will automatically activate once your first plan completely runs out. Choose the auto top-up option for an even more seamless internet experience.

  • Security: Enjoy safer browsing with built-in security features like virtual location, ad blocker, and web protection against malicious sites and trackers.

Frequently asked questions about the Saily Global travel eSIM

An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a virtual SIM card that you install on your device instead of physically inserting into it. The term “eSIM card” isn’t quite right because the point of eSIM technology is that it does not require a physical card, but you still get all the same benefits of a traditional SIM card. eSIMs are more convenient than a SIM card because you won’t have to search for one in a store or kiosk while abroad — instead, tourists can get prepaid mobile data plans from an eSIM app.

Most modern smartphones are eSIM-compatible, including the iPhone (11 or later), iPad (released in 2019 or later), Samsung Galaxy (S20 or later), Huawei P40, Xiaomi (12T or later), as well as many other devices. To find out if your smartphone supports eSIMs, search for your phone’s user guide or browse our full list of eSIM-compatible devices.

No, the Saily Global plan does not cover every country or destination in the world. Currently, the Global plan covers 121 destinations.

The price of your Global plan depends on how much data you buy and for how long. The cheapest option is US$8.99 for 1 GB to use over 7 days.

If you’ve purchased a prepaid Global plan on the website, a QR code will instantly be sent to your email so you can set up your eSIM. Next, download the Saily eSIM app and sign up in a few simple steps. Then scan the QR code you received via email and follow the instructions prompted by the Saily app to install your eSIM. You can also purchase a prepaid Global plan directly through the Saily app instead of on the website. Your plan will automatically activate once you arrive at the first destination of your world trip, as long as you’ve turned on your eSIM and enabled roaming through your device’s settings. From there, enjoy a seamless internet connection while you travel!

Yes, using a Saily eSIM is safe — Saily actually offers built-in security features like virtual location, ad blocker, and web protection that competing eSIM services do not.

  • Virtual location allows you to maintain your location more private by routing your connection through a remote server.

  • Ad blocker decreases the amount of ads on sites as you browse, which in turn saves you data.

  • Web protection reduces trackers and malicious websites based on DNS filtering, which also saves you data.

These features have been developed by the same cybersecurity experts behind NordVPN and allow you to enjoy safer browsing as you travel.

If your eSIM is not working, you can go through a list troubleshooting steps:
  1. 1.

    Check if your device is eSIM-compatible.

  2. 2.

    Ensure you’ve scanned your QR code only once. Your Saily QR code can only be scanned once and cannot be scanned on multiple devices.

  3. 3.

    Make sure your Saily eSIM is turned on.

    • For iPhone: Go to “Settings,” then “Mobile service.” Here, you’ll see a list of your SIMs — tap on your Saily eSIM and make sure you toggle the switch beside “Turn on this line.”

    • For Android: Go to “Settings,” then “Connections.” In the “Connections” menu, select “SIM manager.” Find your Saily eSIM and toggle the switch to “On.”

  4. 4.

    Check if roaming is enabled.

    • For iPhone: Go to “Settings,” then “Mobile service.” Tap on your Saily eSIM and toggle the switch beside “Data roaming” to “On”.

    • For Android: Go to “Settings,” then “Connections.” Select “Mobile networks” and toggle the switch beside “Data roaming” to “On”.

  5. 5.

    Make sure you have a stable internet connection while installing your eSIM.

If you’re still having trouble with your eSIM, contact the Saily support team and they’ll be happy to help you out.

Open the Saily eSIM app, go to phone numbers, and pick a US number. Pair it with a plan for calls and text messages so you can use it as your second phone number. It activates in one tap after a quick identity verification. You can use it alongside any Saily eSIM data plan for travel, sign-ups, and everyday communication.

Frequently asked questions about the Saily Global travel eSIM
What is an eSIM card?
An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a virtual SIM card that you install on your device instead of physically inserting into it. The term “eSIM card” isn’t quite right because the point of eSIM technology is that it does not require a physical card, but you still get all the same benefits of a traditional SIM card. eSIMs are more convenient than a SIM card because you won’t have to search for one in a store or kiosk while abroad — instead, tourists can get prepaid mobile data plans from an eSIM app.
Will a Global data eSIM work on my phone or tablet?
Most modern smartphones are eSIM-compatible, including the iPhone (11 or later), iPad (released in 2019 or later), Samsung Galaxy (S20 or later), Huawei P40, Xiaomi (12T or later), as well as many other devices. To find out if your smartphone supports eSIMs, search for your phone’s user guide or browse our full
list of eSIM-compatible devices
.
Does the Saily Global eSIM include every destination?
No, the Saily Global plan does not cover every country or destination in the world. Currently, the Global plan covers 121 destinations.
How much is a prepaid Global eSIM plan?
The price of your Global plan depends on how much data you buy and for how long. The cheapest option is US$8.99 for 1 GB to use over 7 days.
How do you use a Saily Global data eSIM?
If you’ve purchased a prepaid Global plan on the website, a QR code will instantly be sent to your email so you can set up your eSIM. Next,
download the Saily eSIM app
and sign up in a few simple steps. Then scan the QR code you received via email and follow the instructions prompted by the Saily app to install your eSIM. You can also purchase a prepaid Global plan directly through the Saily app instead of on the website. Your plan will automatically activate once you arrive at the first destination of your world trip, as long as you’ve
turned on your eSIM
and enabled roaming through your device’s settings. From there, enjoy a seamless internet connection while you travel!
Is it safe to use a Saily Global eSIM?
Yes, using a Saily eSIM is safe — Saily actually offers built-in security features like virtual location, ad blocker, and web protection that competing eSIM services do not.
Virtual location allows you to maintain your location more private by routing your connection through a remote server.
Ad blocker decreases the amount of ads on sites as you browse, which in turn saves you data.
Web protection reduces trackers and malicious websites based on DNS filtering, which also saves you data.
These features have been developed by the same cybersecurity experts behind NordVPN and allow you to enjoy safer browsing as you travel.
Why is my eSIM not working?
If your
eSIM is not working
, you can go through a list troubleshooting steps:
1.
Check if your device is eSIM-compatible.
2.
Ensure you’ve scanned your QR code only once. Your Saily QR code can only be scanned once and cannot be scanned on multiple devices.
3.
Make sure your Saily eSIM is turned on.
For iPhone: Go to “Settings,” then “Mobile service.” Here, you’ll see a list of your SIMs — tap on your Saily eSIM and make sure you toggle the switch beside “Turn on this line.”
For Android: Go to “Settings,” then “Connections.” In the “Connections” menu, select “SIM manager.” Find your Saily eSIM and toggle the switch to “On.”
4.
Check if roaming is enabled.
For iPhone: Go to “Settings,” then “Mobile service.” Tap on your Saily eSIM and toggle the switch beside “Data roaming” to “On”.
For Android: Go to “Settings,” then “Connections.” Select “Mobile networks” and toggle the switch beside “Data roaming” to “On”.
5.
Make sure you have a stable internet connection while installing your eSIM.
If you’re still having trouble with your eSIM, contact the Saily support team and they’ll be happy to help you out.
How to get an eSIM with a US phone number?
Open the Saily eSIM app, go to phone numbers, and pick a US number. Pair it with a plan for calls and text messages so you can use it as your second phone number. It activates in one tap after a quick identity verification. You can use it alongside any Saily eSIM data plan for travel, sign-ups, and everyday communication.
